title: Col de Turini and Roya Edges
slogan: A 98 km loop out of Sospel
story: Rally-road mythology with sea-level start. A 98 km loop that starts and ends near Sospel, about 1 h 53 of riding. The climb of the day is Col de Turini. It tops out at about 1,750 m. It is a high-mountain day.

title: Verdon Gorge Grand Day
slogan: A 210 km loop out of Grasse fuel
story: Big canyon drama, long day discipline. 210 km round from Grasse - plan on about 3 h 37 of riding. On the way it passes Castellane, Verdon balcony road and Lake Sainte-Croix. The highest point is about 1,450 m.
